Boutique Store

Forget something? MSLM offers high-quality winter sports gear and accessories!

Goggles: Renowned brands such as Oakley, Scott, Smith, and Spy for crystal-clear vision in all winter conditions. Plus, enjoy the sun in style with Pit Viper Sunglasses.

Helmets: Protect yourself in style with helmets from Giro, Oakley, Smith, and Spy. Each helmet is a fusion of cutting-edge technology & sleek design, Stay safe and look wicked on the mountain.

Gloves/Mitts: Warmth meets functionality with gloves/mitts from Auclair, Dakine, Gordini, & Kombi. From skiing & snowboarding to building snowmen, keep your hands cozy and agile.

Facecover: Elevate your winter wardrobe with face covers & hats from Airhole, Blackstrap, Buff, CTR/Chaos, Seirus, and Stanfield’s Hot Chillies. Stay chic while shielding yourself from the winter chill.

Winter Essentials: We’ve got you covered with hand/toe warmers, Advil, boot gloves, kids leash/harness/edgie wedgie, chapstick/sunscreen, antifog solutions, and MSLM stickers.

On the Slopes Accessories: Navigate the mountain with precision using Gabel Poles & Bumsavers. Keep your essentials organized in boot bags & protect yourself with wrist guards.

Exclusive MSLM Branded Apparel: Show your love for winter sports with Campus Crew MSLM branded apparel. Cozy hoodies & flannels, there’s a perfect outfit for your après-ski moments.

Where to Eat

Mount St. Louis Moonstone accepts cashless payments only. Transfer cash to Resort Charge/eMoney loaded directly to your Louis Xpress card at Guest Service locations across the resort. Automatic Teller Machines (ATM) are not available.

Podium Pass holders receive a 15% discount at
the Cafeteria, Beavertails, the Boutique & Equipment Repairs

Louis Chalet

Breakfast
  • Full Breakfast

    Two freshly cracked eggs, two strips of bacon and hash browns.

  • P.L.T.

    Peameal bacon, lettuce, tomato and cheddar on twelve-grain bread.

  • Egg Bites

    Two-egg sous vide bites with red peppers, bacon, and cheddar

  • Sunrise Croissant

    Toasted Croissant with fried egg, cheddar cheese &amp; bacon

  • Toasted Bagel

    Montreal bagel with your choice of jam, butter or cream cheese.

Grill
  • Grass-fed Beef Smash Burger

    Two freshly grilled 3 oz patties of 100% Ontario grass-fed beef, house-made burger sauce and melted American cheese, with kettle chips.

  • Black Bean Burger

    Black bean patty, tomato, lettuce and burger sauce, with kettle chips.

  • Debreziner Sausage

    Old World-style sausage on a brioche bun.

  • All-beef Hot Dog

    Shopsy’s all-beef hot dog on a brioche bun.

  • Nashville Hot Fried Chicken Sandwich

    Nashville hot fried chicken with zesty pickles on a soft bun, with kettle chips.

  • Fried Chicken Sandwich

    Fried chicken with zesty pickles on a soft bun, with kettle chips.

Sandwich Stop
  • Butter Chicken Burrito

    Chicken breast simmered in butter chicken sauce, with white rice and fresh spinach in a flour tortilla.

  • Classic Reuben on Rye

    Swiss, medium cheddar and gouda cheeses on multigrain bread.
